title: UK Pavilion, Expo 2025 Osaka
creator: Woo Architects; Emma Owens, lead
description: Perforated aluminum panels on the exterior of the pavilion reference textile punch cards, whose "programmable" codes helped fuel the Industrial Revolution in the UK and later in Japan.

title: Panasonic Group Pavilion, Expo 2025 Osaka
creator: Yuko Nagayama Associates; Yuko Nagayama, lead
description: The pavilion is named "The Land of NOMO," a fantasy land for children to explore, where technology of sound and vision create multisensory interactive experiences.
subject: world expositions;women architects;corporate pavilions
image_alt_text: Silver metallic cubic building covered by a curving assortment of circular frames containing curving pink and clear glass.

title: Uzbekistan Pavilion, Expo 2025 Osaka
creator: Atelier Bruckner; Shirin Frangoul-Bruckner, lead
description: The pavilion includes colored tile against a tan brick and wood frame exterior to highlight the extensive history of ceramics production in Uzbekistan, seen more fully in a 360 degree projection of an architectural tiled facade on the interior.

title: Bahrain Pavilion, Expo 2025 Osaka
creator: Lina Ghotmeh
description: Evoking the form of a Bahraini dhow created with Japanese skilled carpentry, the pavilion emphasizes global connectedness

title: Poland Pavilion, Expo 2020 Dubai
creator: WXCA; Marta Sękulska-Wrońska, lead
description: The metallic superstructure over the wood-paneled pavilion represents white storks, as 25% of the world's population of them nests in Poland.

description: The white pavilion sits at the end of a path in a pool of water. A white metal grid superstructure is covered in triangular shapes of white cloth in irregular patterns, occupying different quarters of the grid and turned in different directions, resembling many sails blowing in the breeze.
